notes.title: 🌌 A Fresh New Look for Shadow's Descent! 🌌
notes.content:
🌌A Fresh New Look for Shadow's Descent!🌌

Hello, fellow explorers of the shadows!

We’re thrilled to share some exciting news with you today: Shadow's Descent has a brand-new cover image! 🎨 This updated visual represents the haunting and immersive atmosphere of our game even better, drawing you deeper into the mysterious world we’ve created.

Why the Change?

When we first designed the original cover, it was based on the early vision of Shadow's Descent. As the game evolved, with your feedback and our development efforts, we realized it was time for the cover to reflect the experience you’ll find in the game today. The new image is darker, more atmospheric, and captures the psychological horror we want you to feel when playing the game.

What’s New in the Artwork?

[olist]
 A darker and more immersive tone: The updated visual emphasizes the eerie hospital setting, shrouded in shadows and mystery.
 Enhanced details: From the unsettling corridors to the creeping darkness, every element is designed to pull you into the tension and thrill of Shadow's Descent.
 A glimpse into the unknown: This new cover teases the secrets and horrors lurking within the game, making it irresistible to horror fans.
[/olist]

Check It Out Now!

We’d love for you to take a moment to see the new cover on our [Steam Page](Steam Page Link). While you’re there, don’t forget to share your thoughts! Your feedback continues to shape the journey of Shadow's Descent.

Thank you for being part of this adventure and for helping us bring the shadows to life. We can’t wait to hear what you think about the new look! 🌑

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, beware of what’s hiding in the darkness…

🎮 The Shadow's Descent Team

notes.title: Shadow's Descent is finally available! Dive into the horror now!
notes.content:
Dear players and horror fans,
Today marks a big day for us! After months of hard work, intense development, and careful preparation, we are thrilled to announce that Shadow's Descent is finally available in Early Access! We can't wait to see your reactions and experience this frightening experience with you.


What is Shadow's Descent?

"Shadow's Descent" is a psychological horror game that immerses you in a windowless hospital, where every corner holds dark mysteries and dangers. You play as an investigator trapped in this oppressive place, surrounded by disturbing secrets and pursued by supernatural threats. Each room hides riddles and clues about past events, but beware: the shadows are very real...

What to expect in this release?

In this Early Access version, you will be able to explore a substantial part of the hospital, solve various puzzles, and begin to piece together the disturbing past of this place. We have worked hard to deliver an immersive atmosphere and engaging gameplay.

This version includes:

 A first look at the environments : Discover the oppressive atmosphere of the first areas of the hospital.
 Riddles : Challenge your mind to unlock passages and get clues.
 An immersive sound atmosphere : A chilling soundtrack and realistic sound effects to amplify the tension.


What's coming soon

Early Access is the beginning of this adventure. We plan to add:


 New areas to explore.
 More challenging puzzles and special events.
 Feedback-driven improvements: We want you, the community, to be an integral part of the evolution of Shadow's Descent.


Join us in the discussions!
We look forward to hearing your feedback! Share your experiences, ideas, and even story theories in the community discussions or on our Discord. Your suggestions are essential to improving the game and making the experience even more immersive and terrifying.

So, are you ready to face the shadows? Download Shadow's Descent now and begin your investigation… if you dare.

Thank you all for your support,
Xavier CEO of Cornet Dev and all the team.
